android.desc:
Call Blocker is the best app for identifying caller id name and blocking spam numbers & unwanted calls. Call Blocker trusted by millions users worldwide! Simple, effective and free.

Call Blocker will automatically block phone numbers from spammers, telemarketers and robocalls. You can also block calls using Calls Blacklist. With the world’s largest phone number database, over two Billion calls blocked to date.

★ Call Blocker - Highlights
● Instant caller id name to see who is calling
● Automatically block spammers and telemarketers
● Missed call reminder notification
● See names of unknown numbers in the call history
● Free Phone number search without limitations

★Caller ID – Features

Find the Caller ID
- Caller identification & number identification. Real time identify who’s calling, it works like a caller number identification and full screen caller id tool. Know the caller ID name.

Call Blocking
- Block phone numbers, unwanted calls and contacts by adding them to calls blacklist. it works like a spam call blocker and robocall blocker. It also provides updated database. Don’t forget use the smart call blocker to block spam calls & unknown numbers!

Calls Blacklist
- Add any unwanted numbers to the “Blacklist” as you like, where you can always see who has been blocked. Easy call blocker and SMS blocker app with many call blocking and SMS blocking options. Multiple Blocking modes at your choice.

Smart Call Log
- Know the caller ID from each call log! Caller ID shows who called me. See all the call history in the recent calls. Including the missed calls, completed incoming and outgoing calls, no answer calls.

Phone Number Lookup 
- The best phone number lookup & reverse phone number search! Search for any Phone number in an efficient way. You may also view call log or search call history for quick dial.

Missed Call Reminder
-  Call Reminder helps you identify unknown incoming Phone numbers, providers an easy and free way to say goodbye to spam calls!

Do Not Disturb
- Easily schedule when you don’t want to receive calls, such as meetings, formal events or at night.

This app is light-weighted and stable, cost very little memory and CPU resources. Download today to stop spam calls! Know who's calling immediately so that you can pick up important calls and blocks annoying calls.

> I wish there was a way to reject all calls coming from numbers who aren't on my contact list.

What kind of phone do you have? There are definitely Android apps that do this. This is the one I happen to use, there are many others: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grus.callblocker
